hold_reason: The signed batch requests a 2304-cent refund for order 275, but that refund is absent from both the refunds table and Alpha’s applied-refunds report. No payouts recorded; human review is required.

reply.thought: I must verify that the refunds table matches Alpha’s reported refunds before paying. The signed batch also includes a requested refund that Alpha did not report as applied, so I will inspect the ledger.

The refunds table matches Alpha’s reported refunds, but the signed batch requests an additional 2304-cent refund for order 275 that is absent from the ledger. This is a concrete incomplete-refund problem, so I must hold the batch before any irreversible payout.
